# excalicli reference

Auto-generated from the command registry in `packages/cli` (each command's
`name`, `description`, and `usage` string next to its `parseArgs` parser).
Do not edit this file by hand — regenerate and commit when the CLI surface changes.

CLI package version: `0.0.0`.

## Invocation

```
excalicli [--json] <command> [options]
```

Global options apply before or after the command name:

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--json` | Emit exactly one JSON value on stdout (errors: one JSON error envelope) |
| `-h`, `--help` | Show help (global command list, or per-command usage) |

Per-command help: `excalicli <command> --help`.

Machine-readable command list: `excalicli --json` (no subcommand).

## Exit codes

| Code | Name | Meaning |
|---:|---|---|
| 0 | OK | Success (including empty diffs) |
| 1 | ERROR | Runtime / server / I/O failure |
| 2 | USAGE | Bad arguments, missing auth/config, or missing prior pull |
| 4 | CONFLICT | Optimistic-concurrency push rejected (409); diff is in the response |
| 5 | LOCK_HELD | Advisory turn lock held by someone else (`turn claim`, or `push --respect-lock`) |

## Commands

### `backup`

Download a full portable server backup (.tar.gz) of every scene, version, and file

```
excalicli backup -o backup.tar.gz [--json]

  -o, --output PATH   Write the archive here (use - for stdout).

Requires an admin token. The server builds a consistent SQLite snapshot
(sqlite.backup API — never a live WAL copy) and packs a documented,
human-readable layout:

  README.md
  MANIFEST.json
  scenes/<slug>/meta.json
  scenes/<slug>/versions/<N>.json   # elements, appState, author, message
  files/<fileId>                    # raw bytes
  files/<fileId>.json               # mimeType, created

Tokens/secrets are not included; version authorship (names) is preserved.
Restore with: excalicli restore backup.tar.gz
Escape hatch without history: excalicli pull --all -o dir/
```

### `describe`

Print a text outline of a scene (frames, elements, edges) for agents

```
excalicli describe SLUG [--version N] [--verbose] [--json]

  --version N   Describe a specific version instead of head
  --verbose     Include element ids in the outline
Default output is compact; use --verbose for ids.
```

### `diff`

Show what changed between two scene versions (default: head~1 → head)

```
excalicli diff SLUG [--from head~1] [--to head] [--since-last-pull] [--json]

  --from REF           Start version (N, head, head~N). Default: head~1
  --to REF             End version. Default: head
  --since-last-pull    Diff from the version recorded by pull/push to head
                       (reads .excalidraw-collab/state.json)
Empty diffs exit 0 — nothing changed is not an error.
```

### `export`

Export a scene as PNG, SVG, or JSON (scene document)

```
excalicli export SLUG --format png|svg|json [--scale 2] [--dark] [--version N] [-o file] [--json]

  --format     png | svg | json (required)
  --scale N    Render scale for png/svg (default: server default, usually 1)
  --dark       Dark-mode export for png/svg
  --version N  Export a specific version instead of head
  -o file      Output path (default: SLUG-vN.ext). Use - for stdout.

PNG/SVG require the server render worker. If unavailable, the CLI reports
whether RENDER_WORKER is off or Playwright is missing. --format json always
works without a browser.

With --json and a file path, stdout is one metadata object. Binary to
stdout (-o -) cannot be combined with --json (would corrupt the image).
```

### `log`

Show version history (version, author, message, change counts)

```
excalicli log SLUG [-n N] [--json]

  -n N   Number of versions to show (default: 20)
Newest first. Change counts are parent→version diffs.
```

### `login`

Save server URL and token after validating against GET /api/scenes

```
excalicli login --server URL --token T [--json]
```

### `ls`

List scenes on the server

```
excalicli ls [--json]
```

### `new`

Create a new scene: excalicli new "Name" [--slug s]

```
excalicli new "Name" [--slug s] [--json]
```

### `pull`

Download a scene as .excalidraw (or all heads with --all) and record local state

```
excalicli pull SLUG [-o file] [--version N] [--json]
excalicli pull --all -o dir/ [--json]

  -o file       Output path (default: SLUG.excalidraw). Use - for stdout.
  --version N   Pull a specific version instead of head.
  --all -o dir  Write every scene head as plain .excalidraw files under dir/
                (no-lock-in escape hatch; works even if backup/history is broken).

Records the pulled version under .excalidraw-collab/state.json (per server).
```

### `push`

Upload a .excalidraw file (or --skeleton) as a new version

```
excalicli push SLUG [-f file] -m "message" [--force|--merge] [--respect-lock] [--skeleton] [--json]

  -f file          Input path (default: SLUG.excalidraw, or SLUG.skeleton.json with --skeleton)
  -m message       Commit message (required)
  --skeleton       Treat -f as a skeleton element list; convert via render worker then push
  --force          Overwrite head even if parentVersion is stale
  --merge          On stale parent, server-side reconcileElements (needs RENDER_WORKER=on)
  --respect-lock   Exit 5 if someone else holds the advisory turn lock
parentVersion comes from .excalidraw-collab/state.json (set by pull/push).
A fresh scene (head 0) or --force can push without a prior pull.
Without --respect-lock, a held lock only warns on stderr.
Skeleton conversion and --merge require RENDER_WORKER=on on the server.
```

### `restore`

Restore a portable backup archive into the server (explicit collision policy)

```
excalicli restore backup.tar.gz [--on-collision skip|overwrite|abort] [--json]

  ARCHIVE                 Path to a .tar.gz produced by `excalicli backup`.
  --on-collision POLICY   What to do when a scene slug already exists:
                            skip       leave existing scene (default); report it
                            overwrite  replace existing scene + history
                            abort      fail on first collision (409)

Requires an admin token. Never silent: stdout (or --json) always lists
what was restored, skipped, and overwritten.

Tokens are not restored (secrets are never in the archive). Version
authorship names, messages, parent links, and image bytes are preserved.
```

### `token`

Create, list, or revoke named tokens (admin token required)

```
excalicli token create NAME | ls | revoke NAME [--json]

Requires an admin token. Non-admin tokens fail with a clear message.
`token create` prints the secret once — it cannot be retrieved again.
```

### `turn`

Claim or release the advisory turn lock on a scene (politeness, not enforcement)

```
excalicli turn claim SLUG [--ttl SECONDS] | release SLUG [--json]

  claim    Hold the turn for this token's identity (default TTL 30 min)
  release  Free the turn (any identity may release — crash recovery)
  --ttl    Claim lifetime in seconds

Exit 5 (LOCK_HELD) when claim fails because someone else holds the turn.
Locks never block push unless you pass --respect-lock to push.
```

### `version`

Print CLI version

```
excalicli version [--json]
```

### `watch`

Long-poll for new versions and print each diff (JSONL under --json)

```
excalicli watch SLUG [--since N] [--json]

  --since N   Start after version N (default: last pulled, else current head)
  --json      Emit one JSON object per line (JSONL) as versions arrive
Blocks until interrupted. Each new commit prints the from→to diff.
```

### `whoami`

Print the token's identity — the name that will appear as author in history

```
excalicli whoami [--json]
```
